title: More ways to write and make images
summary:
Five community projects joined the directory, and a round of link and credit repairs made the existing listings easier to explore.

The project directory added SocialScribe, a browser extension for rewriting text with tone and formatting controls, and EzPromptla, which helps turn ideas into image prompts.

Two more community projects joined the directory: the Chinese-language AI text cultivation sandbox 云渺仙途：凡尘篇 and UltimaX Intelligence, an Open-WebUI-based interface for multiple models.

Querynator5000 joined the Hack & Build listing. It offers a browser-based natural-language interface for exploring and manipulating databases, with local persistence.
